Major dependencies by phase: M1 — existing event schema, current identity model (see decision below), backend query API & saved-query store, frontend segment UI; M2 — scheduler/notification service, batch job infra, alert delivery integrations; M3 — dashboard rendering service, richer instrumentation, RBAC/team metadata and export service.

At the same time, scoping unified identity to a later phase raises some backend concerns about whether the upgraded identity system can realistically be delivered in sync with your proposed M2, prompting them to probe the tradeoffs further. Stakeholders now see your roadmap as the starting point for real commitments, not just a thought exercise, and expect you to reconcile feasibility feedback into a sharper version before the cross-functional session.
